title: The Rescue in the Sky
logline: In the morning square the disguised Firuz and the princess tell the far king the whole truth; the inventor is held for the judge, the two fly her home along the river she knows, and days later she travels to his palace and becomes the second pilot of the ebony horse.
moral: The whole truth, told calmly, opens the gate that tricks could not; a promise kept brings everyone home.
tone: Bright finale: light suspense and comedy in the square, one clean reveal, then open sky, homecoming warmth and a laughing last line. Echoes episode 1 in its closing.

beats.summary: The square of episode 4: the disguised Firuz beside the horse offers to test it and names the princess as the one who knows its story.
She walks to the horse hiding her delight; it escapes for two drawings.
The inventor reaches for the knob; two spears cross in front of his nose.
Her condition: tell the king the whole truth.
Cloak and cap fly off: he is Prince Firuz, and the saffron scrap fits the torn turban.
After her testimony the king has the inventor held for the judge.
The king lets them go home; her joy finally shows.
The inventor's eyes at the grille, from the inside this time.
The horse rises before the amazed court and circles the great dome.
She lowers the horse herself; Firuz rides with his hands in the air.
The river she knows: the gold path between the two towers.
Home: the embrace with her mother.
Firuz thanks her and promises her father to bring her to his country with her attendants.
Days later the escort travels by land to his city, the wooden horse on a cart.
Her first wobbling solo flight in the garden of episode 1.
Two pilots in the sunset sky of episode 1. THE END.

subtitles.ar: همس فيروز: «فلنعد أولًا إلى أهلك، ثم نزور قصري كما اتفقنا».|قالت: «نعم، وأخبر الملك بالحقيقة كاملة».|فكشف اسمه وأشار إلى المخترع، ونظرت الأميرة إلى الملك منتظرة الإذن.
subtitles.en: Firuz whispered, “Let us return to your family first, then visit my palace as planned.”|She said, “Yes, but tell the king the whole truth.”|He revealed his name and pointed to the inventor; the princess looked to the king for permission.

subtitles.ar: شهدت الأميرة بما جرى منذ اختطافها،|فأمر الملك أن يوقفوا المخترع حتى يسمع القاضي أقواله.|ثم أذن لهما باختبار الحصان والعودة إلى أهلها، وحفظه في الساحة حتى المحاكمة.
subtitles.en: The princess explained what had happened since her abduction.|The king ordered the inventor detained for the judge|and allowed the pair to test the horse and return to her family, keeping it secured until the hearing.

subtitles.ar: ركب فيروز والأميرة معًا، وتحققا من المقابض والحبال.|أدار الأمير مقبض الصعود فارتفع الحصان أمام الملك والحراس بدهشة، ثم دار بهما دورة قصيرة فوق القصر.
subtitles.en: Firuz and the princess mounted together and checked the controls and ropes.|He turned the ascent knob, and the horse rose before the amazed king and guards, circling once above the palace.

subtitles.ar: طارا فوق الحقول والأنهار حتى ظهرت جبال وطن الأميرة.|خفضت الحصان بنفسها حين رأت قصر أهلها قريبًا تحتها،|وتبعا مجرى نهر تعرفه جيدًا.
subtitles.en: They flew over fields and rivers until the mountains of the princess’s homeland appeared.|She lowered the horse when her family’s palace came into view,|following a river she knew well.

subtitles.ar: هبطا بسلام، واستقبلهما أهلها بفرح كبير.|شكر فيروز الأميرة على شجاعتها وحسن تدبيرها، ووعد أن يعود بها إلى بلاده مع حاشيتها،|وجلسا يرويان ما حدث.
subtitles.en: They landed safely, and her family welcomed them joyfully.|Firuz thanked her for her courage and resourcefulness and promised to take her to his country with her attendants.|They sat together and told what had happened.

subtitles.ar: وبعد أيام، سافرت الأميرة مع فيروز وحاشيتها إلى قصره كما وعدها،|بعد أن ودعت أهلها بفرح. تعلمت قيادة الحصان، ثم ضحكا:|«صار في بلادنا طياران!»
subtitles.en: Days later, the princess traveled with Firuz and her escort to his palace, as promised,|after a joyful farewell to her family. She learned to fly the horse, and they laughed,|“Now our kingdoms have two pilots!”

owner_questions: SCRIPT: in P4 the Arabic 'وحفظه في الساحة حتى المحاكمة' and the English 'keeping it secured until the hearing' can be read as the horse being kept in the square, yet the pair fly home on the horse in P5; default: the one kept until the hearing is the inventor, shown being led into the closed court of episode 4 with his eyes at the grille, and no lettering says who 'it' is.

SCRIPT: the English of P4 shortens the Arabic ('until the judge hears his statement' becomes 'for the judge', 'in the square' is dropped) and the English of P7 says 'resourcefulness' for 'good planning'; both languages are kept verbatim.

The film opens on the last frame of HORSE-04 (the craftsman's hand at the knob, the inventor staring at the crimson sash corner) and the inventor is stopped by a guard before he can speak; default: keep this bridge.

The reveal of Firuz's name is staged as throwing off the cap and cloak, taking his crown from the toolbox and showing that the saffron scrap fits the inventor's torn turban; the scrap then goes to the captain as evidence. Default: keep.
The arrest is softened: nobody touches the inventor; two guards walk beside him with crossed spears and a gate is barred. Default: keep it light.
Seating on the horse: the princess rides in front (nearest the hidden DOWN lever she uses in P6) and Firuz behind, reaching past her to the UP knob in P5. Default: keep.
The 'ropes' of P5 are drawn as one crimson safety cord round both riders, checked with a tug, plus green ticks for the two controls. Default: keep.
The 'short circle above the palace' is flown round the great tangerine dome, leaving a ring of gold ribbon, with the inventor's eyes watching from the grille. Default: keep.
The river she knows is flown low between the two towers of episode 2, and the sun's glints line up into the gold path of the password. Default: keep the callback.
The family is her father (royal blue and silver), her mother, the maid, the two guards and the roof cat from episodes 2 and 3; mother and daughter embrace. Default: keep.

P8: the escort travels BY LAND (as she chose in episode 3): the princess on a white horse, Firuz on the bay, the maid on a donkey, two guards on foot, and the ebony horse on a cart pulled by a camel with the cat on its saddle; Firuz's father meets them at the gate. The farewell to her family, told afterwards by the narration, is a small round picture. Default: keep.

The flying lesson is set in the garden of episode 1 with Firuz standing where the inventor stood, and the film closes on episode 1's sunset sky with the counters 1 and 2 over the riders and THE END (not TO BE CONTINUED). Default: keep.
